data.narrative:
Periodic Labs is a Seed-stage AI & Software company founded by Liam Fedus and Ekin Dogus Cubuk. The target operates within a competitive sector comprising 1 public comparable (Palantir) and 8 private peers including Waymo, Figure AI, Scale AI, and Reflection AI. The company has raised $300M to date.

Valuation was estimated using the Stage-Progression method, the sole applicable triangulation approach given data constraints. This method applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement to the $300M total raised, yielding an implied valuation of $750M. A Peer-Median approach was not viable; while 16 same-sector comparables exist in the AI & Software universe, none satisfied minimum thresholds for narrow-filter analysis (requiring ≥3 datapoints at identical stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier). Drawing from the broader peer set would introduce material methodological risk.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $638M to $862M, centered at $750M. This range reflects ±15% sensitivity around the stage-progression output. Key uncertainties include (1) the appropriateness of a 2.5x multiplier for this specific founder team and market window, (2) the absence of tightly comparable Seed-stage precedents, and (3) the heterogeneity of the broader AI & Software comp universe. Investors should treat this range as directional pending access to transaction multiples from direct-stage peers or more granular operational metrics.
